# Murmur

> Murmur turns a spoken product idea into a project foundation: a PRD, a competitive research brief, a brand kit, a Jira board with epics and stories, and a Confluence space, created in the user's own Atlassian workspace. It is a foundation, not a finished app.

You record a voice memo in Listener (Murmur's capture app). An agentic pipeline then runs transcription (AssemblyAI), competitor and market research (Exa), a PRD agent (Claude, validated against a typed schema), a brand agent, and Jira and Confluence generators. A full run takes under ten minutes; the measured average is about six.

Murmur ends where automation ends. Turning the foundation into working software is human-led work offered separately by SprintZero Studio in 72-hour sprints.

## Pricing

- One free delivered idea per account.
- Plans are billed per idea delivered, with a monthly idea allowance and no rollover. Failed runs never use an idea.
- Pay-as-you-go single ideas are available without a subscription.
- Current prices: https://www.trymurmur.studio/#pricing
